summary: Root cause of the reported 闪动/对齐效果不好 in large docs: the cursor-sync effect was a passive useEffect (post-paint). WKWebView (Tauri macOS) has no native CSS scroll anchoring, so every first-visit chunk swap painted a VISIBLE drifted frame and the correction landed a paint later; jumps painted spacers→band→alignment across several paints. Fix: (1) sync effect → useLayoutEffect (swap + correction/alignment in the same paint; the ensureChunkMountedForLine bridge re-renders synchronously pre-paint; follow-along scroll no longer lags a frame behind the editor); (2) the usePreviewCursorSync call moved AFTER the gap-compensation layout effect — layout effects run in hook order within a component, and at the old position the sync measured PRE-compensation gap heights and wrote a wrong scrollTop (40 = SkillMetaCard height; shortdoc frontmatter test red at old position, green at new).
